steps.text: In this place of chaos, wind is the only master.
With his massive shield, Spot is just barely managing to carve out a small, precarious patch of safety for himself and Popukar behind him.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*... This sucks! There's gonna be sand in my lungs for weeks! Midnight, you good over there?!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: More or less! I've dealt with the final two bandits! What about you? Is Popukar alright?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: She's great—been hiding behind me the whole time! She's even missing out on all this sand! But get over here and help us if you're done, because I'm gonna give out soon!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: There's a newly released comic back at Rhodes Island, and I'm not kicking the bucket here!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Settle down, just a little longer! I'm sure Orchid and Catapult will be here for us soon!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (I'm scared... the sandstorm's so big... I can't see anything...)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (Spot's shield... it's shaking... he can't hold on much longer...)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (Huh? That's... that's a desert bandit! He snuck past Midnight!)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Spot!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Spot, behind you!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (He's stuck! He won't make it! The machete... the machete's gonna get him!)

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: (No—don't hurt Spot!)
Something strange and searing suddenly wells forth from her eye.
She cannot even process it. The best she can do is heed her instincts and direct that power at the bandit.
An almost invisible energy beam shoots out from her eye.
It does not hit anyone.
Fwmmm—
A peculiar humming sound, seemingly not of these lands, is immediately followed by the expansion of a formless shockwave.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: What was that?!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Dunno! I think something exploded? Hey! Popukar, you alright?!

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Um... I'm alright...
Dumbfounded, Popukar just stands there, unsure of what happened. All she knows is that the scary person was blown away, and Spot is safe now.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: ...It's over?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We're... back?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I think so... There was the hunt... the Gyorin... Hofukaru... How much time passed?
A clear shout, out of place in this desert, comes from behind them.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Could it be... Are these those far-flung Furbidden Lands we've heard about?

steps.name: Yoshitsune
steps.text: (Disappointed growl)

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Masamune?! Yoshitsune?!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: So that wasn't a dream.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Orchid! Catapult! Where have you two been?!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: HEEEY! You two! We lost contact for a minute plus! Thought the desert buried you or something!
Orchid and Catapult turn around. All they see are the Midnight, Spot, and Popukar they know best, running over to them.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: The moment that freak wind stirred up, we lost contact with you! We were almost beside ourselves! At least there's no more combat.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Wait, when did you change outfits? Bold style, I'll say.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Yeah, what's with the clothes? And the cloudbeast and tuskbeast behind you? Someone's been feeding them well.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid! Catapult! You're alright! I'm so happy!
With a look at the three all-too-familiar 'problem children' in front of her, and a glance at the two new companions behind her, Orchid is suddenly unsure whether she wants to laugh or cry first.
For an instant, she recalls them. The do-it-myself Hofukaru. The bright and cheery Suponosuke. The Midnight who grew stubborn as he sought to protect both his country and the one he treasured most.
She feels like she has changed. Become gentler.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I'll tell you all about it later.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: For now, I'm glad you three are alright. The mission went off the rails because of my poor judgment. I'm sorry to put you through that. And good job, all of you.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: What? What is it?

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Time out, time out. Who are you and what did you do with our captain? The real Orchid would've just sighed and called us all problem children.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: True... I do have to admit, your gentle tone, your frank apology... Don't tell me something in that sandstorm possessed you?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I happen to know a few fine ladies well versed in some esoteric Arts. Should we make an appointment?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Uh-oh.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Excuse me?! Are you unhappy with me wanting to be a good captain?! Mission report!

spans.text: with me wanting to be a good captain?! Mission report!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I want a written account of everything that just happened in excruciating detail! And Midnight! Care to explain how you came to know those fine esoteric ladies, hm?

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Yes, ma'am! It's a very long story, ma'am!

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: Ah... yep, that's Orchid. Anyway, I've got comics to read. Midnight, gimme a shout once you figure out what happened.

steps.name: Spot
steps.text: And keep it under thirty words.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yep. Uh-huh. No wonder Orchid blows her top at us sometimes.

steps.name: Popukar
steps.text: Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Ah, a Popukar-shaped beacon of respite. I missed you so much.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh yeah, Masamune.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: You rang?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Say, uh, why don't you come with us for now? Back to our place.

steps.name: Masamune
steps.text: Your place, mew say?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Yup. It's called Rhodes Island. Real sweet place.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The western market could be expanded still, Suponosuke. Thou ought to introduce thine inventions to the nation's people.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: Of course, Your Majesty! My all-new, all-improved Fully Automatic Bunny Dango Machine will ensure we can all have delicious dango anytime, anywhere!

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Before that, I believe we still have a more pressing task. We should erect a statue to our heroes in the city's central plaza.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Indeed... To Madams Orchid and Catapult, to Sirs Masamune and Yoshitsune, and to all the Iju Hunters of times past.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: I pray they've all made safe returns to their homelands.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Also, if possible, I wish to have one for the Lord of Thunder as well.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Why, if I might ask?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Not to commemorate it, nor to pity it. Simply... to remember it.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: ...As you wish.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Yes. Houei ought to remember the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: For it is in our power to pass down their stories, together with this nation's history, for the rest of time.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: You know, I do miss them a little. Catapult always made fun of my inventions, but I'll admit I'd never have made my Dragonator without referencing her weapon.

steps.name: Suponosuke
steps.text: And Masamune, he never knew when to shut up, but he gave me good materials...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Indeed. Peace has returned to us, yet I cannot help feeling... empty, somehow.
Midnight and Hofukaru glance at each other. This time, there is no barrier, no estrangement, between them.
It is at this moment that a samurai enters with a bizarre look on his face.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Your Majesty, Shogun... There are two hunters outside the city requesting an audience with you.

steps.name: Midnight
steps.text: Hunters? Where from?

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: They say... they are from a faraway land—
Hofukaru's heart leaps, filled with an indescribable feeling. She leaves the assembly hall with a hurried pace, and arrives at the city gate.
Outside stand two figures, travel-worn.
One is dressed in a hunting outfit graceful as purple flame, equipped with a bow and glancing vigilantly around her.
The other is in cerulean armor, her aura wild, with a giant sword and shield hitched to her back, and kicking pebbles on the ground out of boredom.
Their outfits, their demeanors, their weapons... all are somewhat inconsistent with how Hofukaru recalls them.
But their faces. They are one and the same.

steps.name: Impatient Hunter
steps.text: I crossed land and sea 'cause I heard there was a beast here worth taking on. You're not about to poach it from me, are you?

steps.name: Calm Hunter
steps.text: I simply heard that the beasts around Houei held very rare materials. If both the rumors are true, then to each our own.

steps.name: Impatient Hunter
steps.text: Ha, fine by me!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Madam Orchid?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Madam Catapult?
An instant later, the spacetime tear is gone.
When the Zinogre opens its eyes again, what greets it is not the ruin beneath Houei. Not the dust, and not the curse's deathly miasma.
It is wind.
Wind mixed with the scent of wet mud, verdant grass, and cool waters. Wind it has known better than any other since the day it was born.
It lifts its head. Bright moonlight filters through the dense canopy, spilling dappled silver across the mossy ground. It hears the rumbling of a distant waterfall, and the chirps of forest insects.
It has returned.
The miko's onerous powers trapped in its body for the last decade are gone now. The turbid curse that tangled about its soul has vanished into thin air.
It lets out a long and drawn-out roar. The sound bears no pain or anger now. No longer is it intended to menace. Now it announces—this rugged forest's true ruler has returned.
It begins to run.
It leaps through the forest on nimble limbs. Its keen claws tear through familiar mud. Its sturdy frame knocks away the shrubs in its path.
It leaps over a rapid stream and comes to a halt by the waterfall. There, it lets the ice-cold splashes cleanse its scar-ridden scales, washing away the dust of another world.
Following its memory, it locates a clifftop. This is its throne. It quietly lies down there, its massive head resting on its front paws, its golden tail coiling around its side like a tired snake.
It shuts its eyes, and calmly falls into a deep sleep.
Snap.
At the light sound of a breaking branch, its ears give a fierce quiver.
It instantly opens its eyes, its pupils glinting in the night, drowsiness vanishes.
It hears.
A set of very steady, very rhythmic footsteps belonging to a creature on two legs. One step, then the next, unwaveringly drawing closer.
There is no fear in those footsteps, only resolution.
Slowly, the Zinogre rises to its feet, gazing in the direction they emanate from. A figure emerges from the shadow of the forest.
There stands a hunter, a wide bamboo hat atop his head, clad in red-and-blue Yukumo robes, the wooden geta on his feet tapping across the rocky ground with a light yet crisp clack-clack.
In his hand is a slender long sword, the glint of the blade subtle yet sharp as it catches the moonlight.
He, too, sees the Zinogre perched atop the cliff.
Two pairs of eyes meet.
There is no hatred, no fear.
The Zinogre's muscles begin to swell, and wisps upon wisps of golden current begin to leap and glimmer across its turquoise scales. It dips its head, and lets out a low, hostile roar.
It is an age-old destiny, etched into its blood.
It does not understand what a 'hero' is, and it does not care what 'sacrifice' means.
All it knows is that in its world, when one strong being meets another, to fight is the one and only form of respect.
